title: Apply New World to Daniel Tyack's website
detail: Set the danieltyack Space's site style to New World (kit, accent, register) once the blocks exist; content stays in the Space's own fields. Design check at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920, 2000 and the console rendered before and after (theme fence). PROGRESS (2026-11-09): the site has worn the new-world style since the Nov 3 remap, but its one page still carries Services and Space blocks (ServicesHero, ServicesStory, SpaceOfferings...), so New World's own blocks never drew. lib/sites/new-world-site.ts builds the New World General kit site for a Space and carries the owner's words into the matching blocks (hero, story, how it works, numbers, closer, contact line, quote, ways in priced from the offerings); live blocks ship without sample rows so the Space's rows draw (LIVE-2053). scripts/new-world-site-sql.mjs prints the SQL (save_website_editor at the exported revision plus a key-scoped set_space_preferences patch: megaTheme new-world, fonts, accent tide, register night). The SQL for danieltyack at revision 68 is in the project folder; it runs after the freeze lifts, with Daniel's go-ahead, and docs/design-systems/new-world/danieltyack-site.json records the apply. The probe passes only once that record carries the applied revision and date. APPLIED (2026-11-09): Daniel ran the generated SQL in the Frequency Community project (revision 68 to 69; theme new-world, accent tide, register night; five published pages). Verified in the database by Claude. The rendered check at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 and the console theme-fence check were not made from the build sandbox and are still owed by the release check.
